text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?! I... lost?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Where did my Bakushin speed go? Is my
name
only Sakura O?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...B-but!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I wasn't prepared for this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To think there was someone out there
that could
beat my speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower... I heard she was fast, but I didn't think she was that fast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Argh! At this rate, she'll take my place
as
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lose my job!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're right about that! They say the
faster you
get, the more people will
respect you!
choice_data_list: なら、もっと速くなろう！
なら、もっと速くなりましょう！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you want, I can do it! For
my speed
was blessed by the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay!
choice_data_list: 次はニシノフラワーに大差勝ちするぞ！
次はニシノフラワーに大差勝ちするよ！
choice_data_list_en: Next time, we'll beat Nishino Flower by a wide margin!
Next time, we'll beat Nishino Flower by a wide margin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does that mean I'll still be doing
sprints?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh!
choice_data_list: 短距離向けトレーニングを完璧にしよう
短距離向けトレーニングを完璧にしましょう
choice_data_list_en: Let's make sure your Sprint training is perfected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So if I win, I get to move to the next
stage. Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like the Sprinters Stakes, it's
another
1,200-meter G1 race. If Nishino
Flower's aiming
to become a sprinter, I'm
confident in saying she
will try her hand
at it.
choice_data_list: 次は『高松宮記念』が目標だ！
次は『高松宮記念』が目標だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Our next goal is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
Our next goal is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Roger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! I'm getting all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Good running today, Bakushin O. I've
come to
say my hellos—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Uh, yes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Your neck!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My neck?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Scrub your neck clean, because next
time I'll be
at your throat! Can't have it
tasting all weird! I
won't be losing again!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: S-scrub? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
